Business.title: Business
Business.description: Represents a business using the BizAssistant app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Business entity.

type.description: The type of business (e.g., shop, supermarket, food, service).

currency.description: The currency used by the business (e.g., ₦ / CFA).

onboardingCompleted.description: A flag to indicate if the business has completed the initial setup.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the BizAssistant app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

phoneNumber.description: The user's phone number. May not be present for all roles.

role.description: The user's role (Owner / Staff / Investor / Admin).

businessId.description: Reference to Business. (Relationship: Business 1:N User). Not applicable for all roles.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Represents an admin user's status for efficient security rule checks.

AdminPermission.title: AdminPermission
AdminPermission.description: Granular permissions for an Admin user.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product sold by the business.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: Represents a sale recorded in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Sale entity.

amount.description: The total amount of the sale.

paymentType.description: The payment type used for the sale (cash/transfer/POS).

timestamp.description: The date and time when the sale was recorded.

userId.description: Reference to User who recorded the sale. (Relationship: User 1:N Sale)

productId.description: Reference to Product. If the sale was for a specific product. (Relationship: Product 1:N Sale)

AiQuestion.title: AiQuestion
AiQuestion.description: Represents a question asked to the AI.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AI Question entity.

answer.description: The AI's answer to the question.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the question was asked.

userId.description: Reference to User who asked the question. (Relationship: User 1:N AiQuestion)

StaffPermission.title: StaffPermission
StaffPermission.description: Represents the permissions granted to staff members.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StaffPermission entity.

userId.description: Reference to User (staff member). (Relationship: User 1:1 StaffPermission)

canRecordSales.description: Indicates whether the staff member can record sales.

canSeeReports.description: Indicates whether the staff member can see reports (owner only).

Invitation.title: Invitation
Invitation.description: Represents an invitation for a staff member to join a business.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Invitation (document ID, typically the email).

email.description: The email of the person being invited.

businessId.description: The ID of the business the invitation is for.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the invitation was created.

MarketCategory.title: MarketCategory
MarketCategory.description: Represents a category in the marketplace.

ChatConversation.title: ChatConversation
ChatConversation.description: Represents a single support chat conversation.

userId.description: The ID of the user who initiated the chat.

agentId.description: The ID of the agent handling the chat.

lastMessage.description: A snippet of the last message for display.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single message within a chat conversation.

imageUrl.description: A data URI for an uploaded image.

SellerBankAccount.title: SellerBankAccount
SellerBankAccount.description: Stores verified bank account details for a seller's payouts.

PaymentTransaction.title: PaymentTransaction
PaymentTransaction.description: Logs a payment attempt for an order.

Payout.title: Payout
Payout.description: Logs a payout to a seller for a completed order.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Represents a user's subscription to a Busmo plan.

SubscriptionTransaction.title: SubscriptionTransaction
SubscriptionTransaction.description: Logs a payment for a subscription.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure has been designed for security and scalability, centered around a multi-tenant model where data is partitioned by `businessId`.

**Key Principles**:

1.  **Centralized User Profiles**: A single top-level `/users` collection serves as the source of truth for all user information, including their `role` and the `businessId` they belong to. This is a critical design choice that prevents data duplication.

2.  **Non-Recursive Security Rules**: Security rules for business-specific data (e.g., `/businesses/{businessId}/sales`) rely on a `get()` call to the accessing user's document in the `/users` collection (e.g., `get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid))`). This pattern is secure and non-recursive because the path being secured is different from the path being read from. It allows rules to check a user's role and business affiliation without needing custom claims.

3.  **Data Silos**: Business-specific data (products, sales, etc.) is nested under `/businesses/{businessId}`. This creates clear data silos, ensuring one business cannot access another's data.

4.  **User-Private Data**: Sensitive, user-specific configurations like staff permissions, subscriptions and transactions are stored under `/users/{userId}/...`. This allows for simple, strict security rules where only the user themselves (`request.auth.uid == userId`) can access their own private documents.
